events.title: Steam Next Fest Demo | Patch Notes
events.summary: What’s changedSteam Next Fest begins from 6pm BST and we're excited to reveal that there will be an exclusive updated Wilderdark demo as part of the event.This update responds to player feedback from our early build April demo. It strengthens the intended gameplay loop, reduces opportunities to skip core content, improves navigation, and presents a more controlled slice of the full game for Steam Next Fest.
